implementation.encoding: Thumb STMIA T1, low registers only
implementation.runtime_helper: gba_stmia_thumb_v3; EWRAM/IWRAM physical ranges only; validates full range before mutating guest state
implementation.discovery: writeback plus bounded abstract-memory shadow update; uncertain or unsupported ranges clear the shadow
implementation.timing: one abstract guest cycle; not ARM7TDMI/GBA bus timing
implementation.fallback: strict-AOT; no interpreter or JIT fallback

headless_gate.command: PATH=/Users/celsoinacio/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.0-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin:$PATH LLVM_SYS_231_PREFIX=$PWD/target/toolchains/LLVM-23.1.3-macOS-ARM64 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=10 GBA020_JOBS=7 GBA020_LINK_THREADS=1 /usr/bin/time -lp sh scripts/verify-gba020.sh > target/gba020/stmia-full-gate.log 2>&1
headless_gate.includes: complete existing GBA-020 fixtures, STMIA O0/O2, C runtime ABI harnesses, strict-AOT manifests and negative package-atomicity cases

runtime_v3_c_harness.result: passed as part of the full gate
cases: base excluded from list and writeback
base as lowest selected register stores the original base
unaligned base aligns each transfer address down and preserves low bits in writeback
faults leave memory and CPU unchanged

read_only_review.result: two implementation findings were fixed before the full gate; reviewer confirmed both closed
read_only_review.scope: LLVM helper wiring and bounded abstract-memory shadow behavior

empty_register_list.diagnostic: unsupported_thumb_instruction at 0x08000084: 0xC000 (empty STMIA register list is unpredictable)

base_in_list_after_lower_register.diagnostic: unsupported_thumb_instruction at 0x08000084: 0xC205 (STMIA base register is included after a lower register; result is unpredictable)

gate_fixture_pool.reason: the LSL parallel benchmark has seven independent fixtures; workers times link threads is bounded to ten

cpu_profile.spot_observation: a concurrent sample during linking reached approximately 8.4 logical CPUs; this was a peak, not sustained usage

tiny_counter_single_compile_probe.method: six warm single-package O2 compiles, three per setting, alternating 1 and 10 LLD threads; each fixture ROM was 256 bytes and had six AOT instructions
tiny_counter_single_compile_probe.result: no reliable speedup measured; process startup and the tiny artifact dominate
tiny_counter_single_compile_probe.limitation: does not measure LeafGreen or a large AOT package

cpu_profile.single_game_pipeline: CFG discovery and LLVM module construction are serial; only final LLD linking is threaded. Higher Cargo jobs do not parallelize a single game compile.
